caption:
25 copy-paste prompts for small business 📌 Save this post.

Emails, reviews, quotes, social posts, hiring, customer service, marketing and admin. Copy a prompt, replace the [brackets], paste it into your AI chat assistant.

3 you can copy right now:

1) Late payment reminder
Write a firm but friendly reminder for invoice [NUMBER] of [AMOUNT], now [X] days overdue. Keep the relationship warm. Max 100 words.

2) Bad review
Reply to this negative review calmly. Acknowledge the issue, no excuses, offer to fix it privately at [CONTACT]. Max 90 words. Review: [PASTE]

3) Before you hit send
Review this email before I send it. Point out anything unclear, too long or possibly rude, then give me an improved version. Email: [PASTE]

Want one new workflow every week? Join our channel from the profile.
